purpose: Close only the E1 heterogeneous-20 middle and high groups by restoring frozen placement experts to deterministic non-SRPT task order on fresh held-out trials.

fresh_nsesche_cohort.pre_registration_check: No E245-E249 tape, reference, canonical, quarantine, summary, or result artifact existed in either the development or frozen-artifact repository before this plan was written. Their only prior appearance was as untouched reserve labels inside pre-registered manifests.

mechanistic_basis.v60_diagnosis: V60's SRPT-ready wrappers raised heterogeneous middle throughput well above the frozen maximum but reduced QPR, while every high candidate fell below both frozen expert endpoints and had one zero-completion seed. The common failure is therefore the imposed SRPT workflow order, not evidence that the frozen placement experts are invalid.
mechanistic_basis.order_change: V61 removes SRPT ordering for the two open loads. Every candidate uses deterministic PlayerId order or the already registered ready-faithful order, so request labels and outcomes cannot influence scheduling.
mechanistic_basis.middle: Load Balance is the frozen QPR leader and FaaSRank the frozen throughput leader. V61 tests their deterministic endpoints plus equal and Load-Balance-weighted ordinal Borda placement while preserving non-SRPT order.
mechanistic_basis.high: Hiku is the frozen throughput leader and OCS the frozen QPR leader. V61 tests their deterministic endpoints plus equal and OCS-weighted ordinal Borda placement while preserving non-SRPT order.
mechanistic_basis.information_boundary: Expert scores use only current preplacement state and frozen model/history inputs; no seed label, workload label, completion, latency, cost, throughput, QPR, or baseline threshold enters online routing.

candidates.definition: Use the frozen throughput leader's faithful placement endpoint without SRPT ordering.
Use the frozen QPR leader's faithful placement endpoint with deterministic stable task order.
Use equal ordinal Borda across the load's frozen throughput and QPR placement experts.
Give the frozen QPR placement expert two ordinal votes and the throughput expert one vote.

selection.gate: For each open load independently, a candidate's five-seed arithmetic mean must be strictly greater than the frozen twenty-seed nine-baseline maximum for all three metrics.
selection.multiple_passers: Choose the passing candidate with the largest minimum relative margin across the three frozen thresholds; tie-break by candidate_id.
selection.failed_load_action: Retain every trial as audit evidence and keep only that load open; do not rerun or replace any selected seed.
